name: dept-arm
description: The old department pipeline as a CodeArmory workflow, up to the merge-to-dev: architect -> pm -> spec -> (expected-red gate) -> [dev -> green]xN loop -> sec -> integrator -> publish. Blacksmith owns the roles (data in postgres); forge owns the volume/exec; the workflow owns the flow. The module lives under src/, as the architect lays it down; the dev/green loop retries the developer until the suite is green or the limit is hit. The publish step opens a git-factory PR of the run's work against dev.

inputs.name: repo
inputs.description: the git-factory repo (under the caller's namespace) the run publishes a dev PR to

with.run: export HOME=/tmp GOCACHE=/tmp/gocache GOPATH=/tmp/go GOBIN=/tmp/gobin; cd /workspace/src 2>/dev/null || { echo 'no src/ module — the spec did not lay the module down under src/'; exit 1; }; go install ./... && go vet ./... && if go test ./... ; then echo 'FAIL: tests pass before dev'; exit 1; else echo 'OK: compiles and RED'; fi
export HOME=/tmp GOCACHE=/tmp/gocache GOPATH=/tmp/go GOBIN=/tmp/gobin; cd /workspace/src && go install ./... && go test ./...

export HOME=/tmp GOCACHE=/tmp/gocache GOPATH=/tmp/go; cd /workspace && echo '=== TREE ===' && find . -type f -not -path './.git/*' | sort && echo '=== go test (src) ===' && (cd src && go test ./... 2>&1 | tail -20)

set -e; export HOME=/tmp; git config --global --add safe.directory '*'; TOK=$(printf '%s' "$GIT_URL" | sed -E 's#.*//token:([^@]+)@.*#\1#'); GF=http://codearmory-git-factory:9002; REPO='${inputs.repo}'; CODE=$(curl -s -o /tmp/r -w '%{http_code}' -X POST "$GF/repos" -H "authorization: Bearer $TOK" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d "{\"name\":\"$REPO\",\"visibility\":\"private\"}"); case "$CODE" in 201|409) ;; *) echo "repo create failed $CODE"; cat /tmp/r; exit 1;; esac; if ! git ls-remote --exit-code --heads "$GIT_URL" dev >/dev/null 2>&1; then D=$(mktemp -d); git -C "$D" init -q; git -C "$D" -c user.email=blacksmith@workshop.invalid -c user.name=blacksmith commit -q --allow-empty -m 'chore: init dev'; git -C "$D" push "$GIT_URL" HEAD:refs/heads/dev; fi; R=$(mktemp -d); git clone -q --branch dev "$GIT_URL" "$R"; find "$R" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 ! -name .git -exec rm -rf {} +; (cd /workspace && tar cf - --exclude=./.git .) | (cd "$R" && tar xf -); cd "$R"; git add -A; git -c user.email=blacksmith@workshop.invalid -c user.name=blacksmith commit -q -m "run: ${inputs.task}" || { echo 'no changes vs dev'; exit 0; }; BR=run/${run_id}; git push "$GIT_URL" HEAD:refs/heads/$BR; RID=$(curl -s "$GF/repos" -H "authorization: Bearer $TOK" | tr '{' '\n' | grep "\"name\":\"$REPO\"" | sed -E 's/.*\"id\":\"([^\"]+)\".*/\1/' | head -1); PR=$(curl -s -X POST "$GF/repos/$RID/pulls" -H "authorization: Bearer $TOK" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d "{\"title\":\"run/${run_id}: ${inputs.task}\",\"source_ref\":\"$BR\",\"target_ref\":\"dev\"}"); echo "$PR"; echo; echo "PR_URL=$GF/repos/$RID/pulls"; echo PUBLISH_DONE
